defs.def: to emphasize sth, especially so that people give it more attention 突出；强调

ex.s: Social roles fail to be highlighted.
ex.t: 社会等级较高的公民____获准居住在距离圆心更近的地方。

ex.s: illustrate an argumentB. highlight an opinion
ex.t: 阐述论点B. 强调观点

ex.s: When St．Augustine admitted his inability to define time， he highlighted one of time 's most noticeable qualities：Time becomes meaningful only in a defined context．Any timekeeping system is valid，and each is as praiseworthy as its purpose．
ex.t: 当圣奥古斯丁承认他无法定义时间时他突出了时间最显著的特征之一：时间只有在特定的语境下才有意义．任何计时系统都是有效的每种都因其目的而值得称赞．

ex.s: highlight an experimentD. introduce an approach
ex.t: 强调一个实验 D. 介绍一种方法

ex.s: Which of the following highlight the Tunisian tour？
ex.t: 以下哪项是突尼斯之旅的亮点？

ex.s: Her monitor has shown that air pollution levels are higher closer to ground level, which has helped highlight concerns that babies and young kids may be at higher risk of developing lung problems.
ex.t: 这项狗狗数据研究是巴吉13岁的主人汤姆·亨特和他的父亲马特的创意。

ex.s: Her final goal is to link the worlds of art and science back together: She believes that bringing the old recipes to life can help develop a kind of learning that highlights experimentation, teamwork, and problem solving.
ex.t: 如果我们能重新发现亲身体验和手工技艺的价值，史密斯说，我们可以将现代见解的精华与我们祖先的灵巧结合起来。

ex.s: To highlight the importance of antiques.

defs.def: to mark part of a text with a special coloured pen, or to mark an area on a computer screen, to emphasize it or make it easier to see 将（文本的某部分）用彩笔做标记；将（计算机屏幕的某区域）增强亮度；使醒目

ex.s: Vinnie confirmed her ability to make a full-length statue by highlighting ______. （    ）
ex.t: 林肯总统最初是如何回应薇妮的请求的？（    ）

defs.def: to make some parts of your hair a lighter colour than the rest by using a chemical substance on them 挑染（将部分头发染成浅色）
the best, most interesting or most exciting part of sth 最好（或最精彩、最激动人心）的部分
areas of hair that are lighter than the rest, usually because a chemical substance has been put on them 挑染的头发

ex.s: Though it is the only unnatural thing on your way up the mountain, still it highlights the whole adventure ___62___ offers a place where you can sit down to rest your ___63___ (ache) legs.
ex.t: 正如歌中所唱，这条漫长而蜿蜒的路"永远不会消失"，它会永远留在游客的记忆中。

ex.s: Tour highlights include the Roman city of Dougga，the underground Numidian capital at Bulla Regia, Roman Sbeitla and the remote areas around Tataouine and Matmata，uique for underground cities.
ex.t: 行程亮点包括罗马古城Dougga、Bulla Regia的地下努米底亚首都、罗马Sbeitla以及Tataouine和Matmata周边的偏远地区，以地下城市而独特。

defs.def: the light or bright part of a picture or photograph （图画或照片的）强光部分

ex.s: She appeared in The Cove, a documentary aiming at highlighting the cruelty of dolphin hunting.
ex.t: 她出演了《海豚湾》，这是一部旨在突出海豚捕杀残忍性的纪录片。

ex.s: Good transitions highlight the ideas that connect different paragraphs and bring the text together as a whole.
ex.t: 好的过渡突出连接不同段落的思想，并将文本作为一个整体连接起来。

ex.s: Can you recommend a place of cultural highlights?
ex.t: 你能推荐一个文化亮点的地方吗？

ex.s: In addition to seeing spectacular mountain peaks and forests, one highlight of their trip was being able to see many different creatures, including deer, mountain goats, and even a grizzly bear and an eagle.
ex.t: 除了看到壮观的山峰和森林外，他们旅行的一大亮点是能够看到许多不同的生物，包括鹿、山羊，甚至还有一只灰熊和一只鹰。

ex.s: The highlight of this exhibition is the painting Clearing After Snow on a Mountain Pass, one of the great works of Tang Yin (1470–1524).
ex.t: 这次展览的亮点是唐寅（1470-1524）的伟大作品之一《关山积雪图》。
